name: mac-performance-monitor
title: Mac Performance Monitor
description: Display graphs and live stats from Mac Performance Monitor app.
author: SARRAF

commands.name: dashboard
commands.title: Dashboard
commands.subtitle: Display your favorite panels
commands.description: Shows favorited panels chosen in the settings

preferences.name: panelCpuTimeline
preferences.title: Panels
preferences.label: CPU Usage Timeline
preferences.description: Show CPU utilization graph over time

preferences.name: panelCpuCores
preferences.label: CPU Cores Grid
preferences.description: Show utilization bars for individual P and E cores

preferences.name: panelMemoryPressure
preferences.label: Memory Pressure and Swap
preferences.description: Show memory pressure graph and swap usage

preferences.name: panelMemoryComposition
preferences.label: Memory Composition Breakdown
preferences.description: Show stacked bar of Wired, Active, Compressed, Cached, and Free RAM

preferences.name: panelGpuWorkload
preferences.label: GPU and Neural Engine Activity
preferences.description: Show GPU graph and AI/ML workload categories

preferences.name: panelDiskReadWrite
preferences.label: Disk Read and Write Records
preferences.description: Show physical disk throughput and taxonomy

preferences.name: panelEnergyHistory
preferences.label: Energy and Power History
preferences.description: Show power consumption and battery graph

preferences.name: panelThermals
preferences.label: Thermals and Fans
preferences.description: Show CPU/GPU die temperatures and fan speeds

preferences.name: panelTopMemoryApps
preferences.title: Leaderboards
preferences.label: Top Memory Apps
preferences.description: Show leaderboard of highest memory consuming apps

preferences.name: panelTopCpuApps
preferences.label: Top CPU Apps
preferences.description: Show leaderboard of highest CPU consuming apps

preferences.name: panelTopGpuApps
preferences.label: Top GPU Apps
preferences.description: Show leaderboard of highest GPU consuming apps

preferences.name: panelTopEnergyApps
preferences.label: Top Energy Apps
preferences.description: Show leaderboard of highest energy consuming apps

commands.name: memory
commands.title: Memory
commands.subtitle: Display Memory Pressure and App Usage
commands.description: Shows memory pressure, composition, and apps sorted by RAM usage

commands.name: cpu
commands.title: CPU
commands.subtitle: Display CPU Cores and App Usage
commands.description: Shows core grid, total CPU graph, and apps sorted by CPU usage

commands.name: gpu
commands.title: GPU
commands.subtitle: Display GPU Usage and AI Workloads
commands.description: Shows GPU graphs, AI/ML categories, and apps sorted by GPU usage

commands.name: disk
commands.title: Disk
commands.subtitle: Display Read/Write Records and App I/O
commands.description: Shows read/write throughput graphs, categories, and apps sorted by disk I/O

commands.name: energy
commands.title: Energy
commands.subtitle: Display Power and Thermals
commands.description: Shows power consumption, thermals, and apps sorted by energy impact

commands.name: copy-ai-instructions
commands.title: Copy AI Instructions
commands.subtitle: Copy Performance Context to Clipboard
commands.description: Copies structured context and database rules for AI agents

preferences.name: defaultRange
preferences.title: Default Time Range
preferences.description: Time window for graphs on initial view

preferences.name: refreshCadence
preferences.title: Live Refresh Cadence
preferences.description: How frequently to refresh stats while command is open

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
